impl_spec: ReSGA(arXiv 2606.04576) Eq.(11) size x tail-risk interaction: alpha_{i,t} = (logCap_{i,t} - cross-sectional mean logCap_t) * (1 - exp(ES_hat_{i,t})); ES_hat = mean of bottom-5% of trailing 252 trading-day daily returns (historical CVaR_95, negative). Cross-sectional demean over K200 union KQ150 members (PIT time-varying membership) intersect liquidity-pass at each month-end. long-only top-25 EW, monthly rebalance, 2005~, 15bps, weight in [0,0.20], Sigma w = 1. Paper sign is market-dependent (US P1-buy reverses in China/Japan) so KR re-validated in BOTH directions: POS (Score=+alpha, big x high-tail long = paper US P1) and NEG (Score=-alpha, small x high-tail long).

POS.note: big x high-tail long significantly UNDERperforms KR BM (PORT_t -2.81, net_IR -0.62). Consistent with paper note that US P1-buy sign reverses in Asian markets.

NEG.note: small x high-tail long has marginal +1.1%p excess but IR ~0.05 and catastrophic MDD 74.6% -> screen_pass=FALSE, no authoritative remeasure path (PORT_t/oos not computed). FMT-01/04/07.

robustness_basis: POS direction got authoritative remeasure: essence F, oos_retention=NA (not computed, sample/holdout insufficient), PORT_t(NW lag-3)=-2.81 (negative). NEG direction failed screening (screen_pass=FALSE) so no authoritative remeasure -> oos/placebo not available. Neither faithful direction clears L3 (oos_retention>=0.5 AND placebo not-FAIL): POS has oos NA + strongly negative realized alpha; NEG never reached the remeasure gate. robustness_pass=FALSE.
fidelity_basis: L4 independent verifier (claude -p) NOT run: gate decision is fail-closed and already QUARANTINE on robustness_pass=FALSE for both faithful directions, so L4 cannot change the outcome. fidelity_pass recorded FALSE (not independently verified) per fail-closed convention. Implementation IS a faithful Eq.(11) reconstruction (no batch_434 fabrication; signal computed = factor def; L/S mapped to long-leg per KR long-only rule).
pit_basis: detect_lookahead CLEAN on factor_engine_resga_2606_04576.R (118 lines); ES uses only trailing 252 trading days, logCap demean is per-date cross-section (no full-sample stat), positions held t+1 by run_monthly_simulation.
contract_basis: POS build_bt_result + audit_bt_result integrity=WARNING (audit_fail=0, audit_warn=1) -> not FAIL -> contract_pass=TRUE. metric_type=backtested.
gate_rule: PIT hard + contract&robustness&fidelity all PASS (unattended 4/4, fail-closed)
